headline: Hisar Metal Industries submits action taken report under special window
hook: Compliance update filed by Hisar Metal
summary: Hisar Metal Industries Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding an action taken report submitted under a special window. The company filed this procedural update as part of regulatory compliance requirements. No financial or operational impact was disclosed in the brief filing. Indian retail investors holding this micro-cap stock should note this is standard regulatory paperwork.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory filing with no direct impact on share price

headline: Hisar Metal Industries files depository participant certificate
hook: Routine compliance filing submitted to the exchange
summary: Hisar Metal Industries Limited has submitted a certificate under SEBI Depositories and Participants Regulations, 2018 to the exchange. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing typically required from listed companies. Retail investors generally do not need to take any action based on this procedural update.
why_it_matters: No direct impact on stock price or business operations.
